events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Colton Cowser hit a two-run homer and Christian Encarnacion-Strand had a three-run double in a seven-run sixth, Trevor Rogers allowed two runs in six innings and the Baltimore Orioles beat the Tampa Bay Rays 10-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowser, Encarnacion-Strand deliver big hits as Orioles score 7 in the sixth and beat the Rays 10-2

headlines.description: — Matt Olson hit a three-run homer to back six strong innings from Bryce Elder, leading the Atlanta Braves past the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-3 on Sunday to avoid a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olson's 3-run homer backs 6 strong innings from Elder as Braves avoid a sweep, beating Arizona 5-3

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Bryan Reynolds, Brandon Lowe, and Nick Yorke each had two RBI to lift the Pittsburgh Pirates over the Boston Red Sox 8-3 after a 2 1/2-hour rain delay on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reynolds, Lowe, and Yorke each drive in 2 runs, Pirates beat Red Sox 8-3 after 2 1/2-hour delay

events.name: New York Yankees at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit a tiebreaking home run in the 10th inning and the New York Yankees beat the Toronto Blue Jays 4-3 on Sunday to avoid a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ben Rice hits tiebreaking homer in 10th as Yankees beat Blue Jays 4-3 to avoid three-game sweep

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami hit a go-ahead homer in the seventh inning and the Chicago White Sox rallied for a 7-5 win over the Detroit Tigers on Sunday to complete a three-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murakami hits go-ahead 7th-inning homer as White Sox sweep Tigers with 7-5 win

headlines.description: — Heriberto Hernández and Javier Sanoja hit home runs late in the game to lift the Miami Marlins over the Cincinnati Reds on Sunday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hernández, Sanoja hit HRs in Marlins 7-1 win over Reds

events.name: San Diego Padres at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Luis Rengifo and Gavin Sheets hit back-to-back home runs in the second inning, Casey Mize allowed three hits in six innings to pick up his first win in a San Diego uniform, and the Padres defeated the Cleveland Guardians 5-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres power surge: 4 homers back Casey Mize’s 1st San Diego win in a 5-0 win over Guardians

events.name: Washington Nationals at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Christian Scott pitched into the seventh inning for the first time since undergoing Tommy John surgery and Luis Torrens hit a two-run homer Sunday, helping the surging New York Mets to a 4-3 win over the Washington Nationals and a three-game series...
headlines.shortLinkText: Scott pitches into 7th, helps Mets past Nats for sweep

headlines.description: — Bryan De La Cruz hit a two-run single in the eighth inning and the Philadelphia Philles overcame a five-run deficit to beat the Minnesota Twins 7-5 on Sunday and sweep the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: De La Cruz hits go-ahead single, Phillies overcome five-run deficit to beat Minnesota 7-5

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Alec Burleson and Jordan Walker both homered and finished with three hits and four RBI, and the St. Louis Cardinals pounded the Chicago Cubs 11-4 on Sunday for a second straight win at Wrigley Field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alec Burleson and Jordan Walker both homer and drive in 4 runs as the Cardinals pound the Cubs 11-4

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Adael Amador and Brett Sullivan each hit a three-run home run Sunday to help the Colorado Rockies beat the San Francisco Giants 13-7.
headlines.shortLinkText: Amador and Sullivan hit 3-run HRs to help Rockies beat Giants 13-7

headlines.description: — Zack Gelof and Lawrence Butler each hit two-run homers, Tommy White had his first major league homer and the Athletics beat the Texas Rangers 5-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gelof and Butler each hit two-run homers to lead the A's over the Rangers 5-2

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Noah Cameron pitched a one hitter, Michael Massey and Bobby Witt Jr. hit home runs, and the Kansas City Royals beat the Los Angeles Angels 3-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noah Cameron dazzles with a 1-hitter as the Royals shut out the Angels 3-0

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Logan Henderson allowed one run in seven innings, Jake Bauers had four hits and two RBI, and the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 6-2 on Sunday to take three of four in the matchup of division leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson shines over 7 innings as the Brewers take 3 of 4 from the Dodgers

headlines.description: — Cal Raleigh and Randy Arozarena homered to lead the Seattle Mariners to a 3-2 victory over the Houston Astros on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners hang on for a 3-2 win over the Astros as Raleigh, Arozarena go deep
